name: RC-B10-0394/2026 – § 8 – Am 5
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on political prisoners in Cuba, in particular the case of Félix Navarro and his daughter Saylí Navarro
part_text: 8. Reiterates its demand to the Council to apply sanctions against those responsible for the repression in Cuba, starting with Miguel Díaz-Canel and the high-ranking officials in charge of regime institutions including the Ministry of the Interior (MININT), the Intelligence Directorate (DI), the Ministry of the Revolutionary Armed Forces (MINFAR), GAESA, the Cuba Oil Union (CUPET), the Cuban Medical Services Marketing Company (CSMC), the Central Unit for Medical Cooperation (UCCM), the National Revolutionary Police Force and the Committees for the Defence of the Revolution (CDR);
